_doc: Performance budgets (Step 41). sim: tools/bench/sim_bench.gd --size N --hours H --offline 8 --check -- the result hash of StressIsland after H simulated hours must stay exactly this (the code may only get faster, never play differently), wall ms per simulated hour and the 8-hour offline catch-up's wall seconds stay under budget (desktop, headless; a busy machine needs the headroom). The hash changes only when the rules do: Step 42 rebalanced the data (780062055 -> 174450136); Step 50 rebuilt the pacing (174450136 -> 3795296932) -- its five-second farm cycle lives 670,000 events in the bench hour where Step 49 lived 45,000, each cheaper (39 us against 136 us), so the hour's budget follows the events, not the code. Step 53 (3795296932 -> 1267453651): a new game has no Momo, so the stress island adds its first itself (where the starter stood, after the land and buildings), and hires are never placed by themselves -- same events and wall time, a different seat of the dice. Step 58 (1267453651 -> 1596734064: the work x2.5 and walks x1.3) was not written here at the time. Step 61 (1596734064 -> 3644538188): every Momo record carries `stop`, `cursor` and `wait` (the player's order) -- the stress island uses none, and with those three fields left out the result is the same as 0.60's (2175119784, the same 374,077 events). Step 69 (3644538188 -> 33606692): the work x2.5 again (work_scale 6.25) and construction x2.5 -- the bench hour now lives 169,335 events instead of 374,077 (each stage is longer), a rule change, not a code change; the offline 8 hours 138,437 events. Step 70 (33606692 -> 3476172638): research opens at the player level and the research record carries `discovered` (the topics whose gate has held); with that field left out the hash is 69's (33606692) and, without the three new research_discovered notices, the same 169,335 events -- the stress island plays the same. Step 71 (3476172638 -> 2220787194): 35 more research topics, and the stress island's record lists the 71 of 72 it has discovered; with `discovered` left out the hash is 69's again (33606692), the same 169,338 events -- it plays the same. Before Step 41 the 30x30 island took 42,527 ms per simulated hour and its capped catch-up 127.9 s. render: tools/bench/render_bench.gd --check, run with godot --fixed-fps 60 -- per second on the large demo island, counts not times (the same on any machine): building rings redrawn, Momo bodies redrawn, buildings and Momo animating, nodes running per-frame code. Before Step 41: 11,520 rings and 3,840 Momo bodies a second, all 347 nodes always processing.
